jurisdiction.name: Equatorial Guinea
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Equatorial Guinea has published no AI-specific law, strategy or guidance that could be found. Its only relevant framework appears to be a 2016 personal data protection law, whose official text is not online and whose supervisory body is reported as not yet operational. The official gazette, parliament, telecom regulator and digital ministry websites could not be reached during this review.
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026, but the official gazette, parliament, telecom regulator and ministry websites could not be found or reached, so no document could be read. The 2016 data protection law is listed as a lead. Equatorial Guinea is marked for a later retry.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: National government sources in Equatorial Guinea were searched, including the official gazette, parliament, the government, ministries and regulators, and no qualifying AI-governance document was found in any category. Several official sites, including the gazette, parliament, the telecom regulator and the digital ministry, were unavailable. The 2016 data protection law and a pending cybercrime and social-media bill are listed as leads to check later, as no official text is online.
coverage_audit.technical_note: Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. gacetaoficial.gq, ortel.gq, mtnt.gob.gq, camaradediputados.gq and senado.gq (guessed domains) proxy 502; guineaecuatorialpress.com reachable but its search returns nothing relevant. Guinea-Conakry AI roadmap results excluded. Not a party to Convention 108. Units covered: Law: Searched, nothing found: no AI law or AI provisions found; official gazette and parliament sites unreachable. Data protection Law 1/2016 and a pending cybercrime/social-media bill held as leads (no official text online).; Government: Searched, nothing found: no national AI strategy, digital strategy with AI pillar, or public-sector AI guidance from the Government or the ministry responsible for telecommunications/digitalisation.; Ministries: Searched, nothing found: no AI documents from education, health, justice, defence, finance, labour or interior ministries.; Regulators: Searched, nothing found: ORTEL (telecom regulator) site unreachable; data protection body (Órgano Rector) reported not operational; no cyber agency or national standards body AI material; banking supervision is regional (BEAC/COBAC).. Not reached: Official gazette (Boletín Oficial del Estado) site unreachable; Cámara de los Diputados / Senado sites unreachable; ORTEL site unreachable; Ministry of Transport, Telecommunications and Digitalisation site unreachable. Could not verify: Ley 1/2016 de Protección de Datos Personales: no official online text; Status of the social networks and cyberspace (cybercrime) bill. binding-law, strategy, government-governance, ethics, risk-assurance, public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, data-privacy, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international, historical: no material found.

leads.title: Ley núm. 1/2016, de 22 de julio, de Protección de Datos Personales
leads.english_title: Law No. 1/2016 of 22 July on the Protection of Personal Data
leads.issuing_authority: Presidency of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea (promulgated law)
leads.note: General data protection law (data-privacy category); creates an Órgano Rector de Protección de Datos Personales, reported by secondary sources as not yet operational. No official full text found online: the official gazette, parliament and telecom regulator (ORTEL) sites could not be reached and no official government host was found. Promote once an official text is located.
